description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateInterviewModel class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It models interview data for candidates in a recruitment system, including properties like candidate info, vacancy info, interviewers, interview date/time, and notes. The class implements serialization and normalization traits and is annotated with OpenAPI schema properties for API documentation.

classes.name: CandidateInterviewModel
classes.description: A model representing interview data for a candidate, used for API responses within the OrangeHRM recruitment module.
